newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street struggles for clear direction.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street struggles for clear direction.

text.p: Wall Street shares shifted between gains and losses in early trading on Thursday, unable to find clear direction although supported by mild strength in the bond market.
"The stock market is kind of flat after struggling to come back a bit late yesterday," one trader said. "It is getting some help from the bond market but it is looking tired here."
The Dow was off 10 points at 7347, although advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a nine to eight ratio.
The long bond was up 10/32, back at a seven percent yield.
